hero.description: Frontend developer and UX researcher bridging the gap between clean engineering and meaningful user experience. Backed by 13 peer-reviewed publications on usability, accessibility and serious games.

about.title: The person behind the
about.lead: I build software that genuinely solves problems — technology that feels natural to use, regardless of who's using it.
about.p1: My path has been anything but conventional. While most developers build portfolios of side projects, I spent three years embedded in academic research — co-authoring 13 peer-reviewed publications on usability, accessibility, and serious games alongside teams from EPN, UDLA, and PUCE.
about.p2: Two projects define what I care about most: Ludominga, a serious game platform for people with intellectual disabilities, and PAR, a telerehabilitation tool for respiratory therapy patients — both free, open-access, and built to reach the people who need them most.
about.p3: I'm detail-oriented by nature and by training. I don't consider something finished until it meets the need it was built for — not just technically, but from the user's perspective.

quality.title: Quality-driven
quality.desc: I don't just ship features — I verify they work, make sense, and hold up under real use.
